# Pictures of the image content test

Real pictures, each under a free licence, taken from the corpus of
`bun run bench:image-content` (`tests/bench/image-corpus/manifest.json`).
`tests/server/assets/image-content.test.ts` reads them: what is counted in
a photograph, a screenshot, a logo and a diagram, large ones among them.
